maddeler.e:
نختتم (form VIII)
# نَخْتَتِمُ (naḵtatimu) /nax.ta.ti.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# نُخْتَتَمُ (nuḵtatamu) /nux.ta.ta.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# نَخْتَتِمَ (naḵtatima) /nax.ta.ti.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# نُخْتَتَمَ (nuḵtatama) /nux.ta.ta.ma/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
